text.answer: Senna is a support marksman whose Mist increases her attack damage, attack range and critical strike chance. She combines physical damage from attacks and beams with healing, camouflage and a global shielding beam.
text.counterplay: Limit repeated trades, spread away from marked allies and respect approaches concealed by her mist.

text.answer: Her attacks take longer to fire, deal bonus physical damage and briefly grant movement speed. Attacks and abilities mark enemy champions; a subsequent hit consumes the mark for Mist and bonus physical damage based on current health. Collecting Mist from champions and nearby deaths increases her attack damage, with attack range and critical strike chance gained at stack thresholds.
text.counterplay: Back away after being marked and avoid letting her extend trades with follow-up hits.

text.counterplay: Avoid lining up behind her beam target and limit sustained trades that let her keep attacking.

text.answer: Senna surrounds herself with mist that grants camouflage; allied champions entering it gain camouflage too, and affected champions gain movement speed. Camouflaged allies outside the mist can appear as wraiths that hide their champion identities. Camouflage can return after stealth-breaking actions stop.
text.counterplay: Treat the mist as a possible team approach and avoid committing based on a wraith's apparent identity.

text.counterplay: Move away from the beam's center and account for shielding in fights far from Senna.
